**Read**

Bearish bias below 62921.235 [1]. The news backdrop is also not supportive: BTC hit a three-week low [12], slid on July’s final session [17], mining difficulty fell 14% [11], and a cold-wallet attack remains a concern [13]. Social sentiment is mixed, but the higher-engagement macro voices lean neutral/bearish [22][24][25], while the loud bullish posts are hype rather than evidence [21][26].

So the near-term bias is down unless BTC reclaims 62921.235 [1]. A daily close below 62211.53333333 [1] would point toward 61030.92 [1]. Above 62921.235 [1], the bias turns neutral-to-up toward 63987.215 [1]. ATR is 1699.37957211 [1], so expect that range of noise around these levels.
